source_scope: Independent inspection of the complete final 252-line frozen snapshot and complete 188-line authoritative 2014 first-edition extraction, with comparison to the previously audited repaired text. No questions, key, reader responses, grades, browsing, prior-game knowledge, or other-edition PDF used.
verdict_basis: Final exact-byte snapshot retains all six resolved repairs. Complete final rules coverage confirms material setup, legal actions, costs, destinations, public information, timing, exceptions, noble acquisition, scoring, and end conditions. No material contradiction or important gameplay omission identified. Only administrative stamping differs from the previously audited repaired text.

prior_finding_resolutions.explanation: Both unsupported depleted-supply under-taking exceptions removed. Revised summary teaches the printed three-different-gems action and does not invent a ruling for source-unresolved supply states.
Explicit all-player, all-times token visibility requirement added.
Received noble tile explicitly placed face-up in front of recipient.
Quick-reference row now labels ten noble tiles as box inventory, consistent with setup using players plus one.
Removed unsupported level-characteristic column, card corner positions and 0–5 range. Remaining description of bonuses, costs and possible zero prestige is consistent with source.
Never shown changed to without showing it when reserving; later purchased-card display requirement remains explicit.

checked_claims.claim: Inventory: 40 tokens, seven each of five gem colors, five gold; 90 developments split 40/30/20; ten noble tiles.
Shuffle three development decks separately; arrange increasing levels bottom to top; reveal four per level.
Shuffle nobles, reveal players plus one, remove unused nobles; six sorted accessible token piles.
Two players use four gems of each color and three nobles; three players use five gems of each color and four nobles; gold unchanged; four players use full inventory and five nobles.
Youngest starts; clockwise; choose exactly one of four actions.
Take three different gem tokens, or two same-color tokens only with at least four of that color available before taking.
Gold cannot be selected by ordinary gem-taking actions.
checked_claims.qualification: Reserving is explicitly the only way to get gold.

checked_claims.claim: No invented fewer-than-three-colors token-taking exception remains.
checked_claims.qualification: Extraction supplies no depleted-supply under-taking exception. Summary now supplies none either; no opposite unresolved rule is asserted.

checked_claims.claim: Reserve one face-up card or top card from a deck without revealing a blind draw; cards remain in hand; max three; cannot discard; only holder may purchase.
Reservation gives one gold if available and remains legal if gold supply is empty.
checked_claims.qualification: Reference row 220 abbreviates the action; explicit exception is stated in turn structure and full action rules.

checked_claims.claim: Purchase exactly one face-up market card or own card reserved on an earlier turn.
Pay token cost less prior-card bonuses; a joker replaces one required color token; all spent tokens including gold return to central supply.
Sufficient bonuses allow purchase without spending tokens.
Bonuses accumulate by color and remain discounts; they create no physical tokens or change; no separate bonus cap.
checked_claims.qualification: The rule defines each bonus as a token-equivalent discount and keeps acquired cards visible. No independent per-color bonus cap is stated; finite card inventory still bounds actual accumulation.

checked_claims.claim: Purchased cards sorted by color and staggered with bonuses and prestige visible at all times.
Immediately refill purchased or reserved face-up cards with same-level card; empty deck leaves spaces empty.
All held tokens visible to every player at all times.
End-of-turn limit of ten tokens includes gold; temporary excess during action is allowed; return chosen excess including newly drawn gold.
checked_claims.qualification: Limit is expressly at end of turn, jokers expressly count, and any newly drawn tokens may be returned. Summary turn order checks limit before nobles; extraction does not expressly order these two end-of-turn operations, but noble eligibility uses only card bonuses so no material difference follows.

checked_claims.claim: At end of active player’s own turn, check nobles; at least required card bonuses only; visits automatic, cannot refuse, not an action; at most one, choose if multiple qualify; three points each.
checked_claims.qualification: End of each turn at line 202 is read in the explicit own-turn context at line 137, not as checking all opponents after another player turn.

checked_claims.claim: Take obtained noble tile and place it face-up in front of recipient.
Unchosen qualifying nobles remain available on later turns.
checked_claims.qualification: Only the chosen tile is obtained. Other players can still obtain remaining tiles before a future turn.

checked_claims.claim: Fifteen or more prestige triggers completion of current round for equal turns; highest total prestige wins including nobles; fewest purchased developments breaks points tie.
checked_claims.qualification: Detailed END OF THE GAME section resolves the abbreviated source overview at lines 51–52. Triggerer may lose to another player in final round. Source supplies no additional tiebreak after equal points and equal purchased cards; summary adds none.

checked_claims.claim: Unsupported card-field coordinates, exact five-point ceiling and level-by-level cost/point generalizations have been removed.
checked_claims.qualification: Cards worth prestige and/or bonuses at source line 48 supports that a card may contribute zero prestige. Layout and full value distribution cannot be verified from this extraction.

checked_claims.claim: Ten noble tiles describes box inventory rather than active nobles.
Designer and 2014 publication attribution.
Metadata gives exact range 2–4 and 30-minute play time.
checked_claims.qualification: Extraction explicitly covers two and three and an example for four but does not state overall range or duration. This is an evidence limit for retained administrative metadata, not a proven gameplay error.

source_limitations: This source does not resolve under-taking when fewer than three gem colors remain, optional smaller token draws, passing, or further ties after equal prestige and equal purchased-card count. The revised summary supplies none of these rulings.
Exact player-count metadata and playing time are not fully established by this extraction; designer and publication year are supported. This does not change the gameplay verdict.
Verification metadata and banner are administrative stamping. Their changes add no game rule and are consistent with this final audit verdict.

changes: Line 11 verification status: minor_issues to verified.
Line 18 verification banner updated to Verified with no significant issues found.
